theme: Light mode by default, premium high-contrast (dark mode supported but secondary)

headings.font_family: Cabinet Grotesk, General Sans, or Outfit
headings.description: Apple-level refinement. Never use Inter for headings. Keep it cinematic and crisp.

body.font_family: Inter, SF Pro Text, or Manrope
body.description: Highly legible, clean geometric sans for UI and body copy.

colors.description: Premium white/light surfaces with deep black/charcoal typography. 'Apple product-page refinement'. Colors should feel structural, relying on grayscale hierarchy and subtle warmth.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Crystal Glass' (backdrop-blur-xl with bg-white/70 and a delicate border-white/20 inner stroke) for sticky headers and floating UI. Never use fully transparent backgrounds behind text.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-black/5 for soft definition. Avoid heavy shadows; use diffuse ambient shadow (shadow-sm or custom 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle digital neural network particle backgrounds in hero, but keep it extremely minimal so it doesn't distract from the typography.

motion.scroll: MANDATORY: Use Lenis for buttery smooth scrolling to achieve that premium cinematic feel.
motion.interactions: Smooth 60fps-feeling motion on hover. Buttons should have subtle scale (active:scale-95) and elegant transitions.
motion.scroll_driven: Use framer-motion for scroll-driven reveals (opacity and slight Y-axis translation). Content should smoothly transform as user scrolls.

particles.usage: Use for the 'subtle animated particle field / intelligent network motion' in the background of the hero section. Configure with fpsLimit: 60, low density, very subtle light gray/silver colors, and slow movement that gently reacts to mouse hover (interactivity: repulse/grab). DO NOT make it visually loud.

layouts.marketing_page: Generous padding (p-12, py-24 to py-32). Cinematic large hero. Scroll-driven storytelling from Hero -> AI Employee -> Channels -> Dashboard. Use Bento grids for features, breaking symmetry.
layouts.dashboard: High-density functional grid. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Clean, sharp, cardless or rounded-2xl widgets with 1px border. Navigation on the left or clean top nav.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or smooth rounded-xl. High contrast (black background, white text).
components.cards: Subtle border-black/5, rounded-2xl, bg-white. No heavy drop shadows.
components.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized to look premium. Light gray backgrounds (bg-zinc-50) for inputs, focus rings in subtle zinc-300.
components.toasts: Use Sonner for minimal, high-contrast toast notifications.

media.hero_overlay: Max overlay opacity bg-black/10 or bg-white/40. The background should breathe.

hotel_architecture.description: Luxurious minimal resort architecture. Use for business outcome or trust sections.

hotel_reception.description: Premium hotel reception desk. Good for grounding the 'India-first, hotels' use case.

abstract_ai_glass.description: Abstract 3D glass shapes with light. Can be used for floating elegant AI employee/voice representations.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text and 3:1 for large text. Hover states must have explicitly defined text colors.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable to achieve the cinematic/Apple-style look.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
For the dashboard, use cardless or 1px border minimal styles rather than standard bulky shadows.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Use the provided image URLs.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds under content.
Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react for elegant, clean linear iconography.
Ensure all components are thoroughly responsive, mobile-first.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install @tsparticles/react, @tsparticles/slim, framer-motion, and lenis for scrolling and background effects. NOTE: Ensure you strictly use .js/.jsx extensions for React components as required by the environment.
instructions_to_main_agent.landing_page_flow: 1. Hero: Large cinematic typography, tsParticles network background (very subtle, reacting to mouse). 2. AI Employee Story: Floating glassmorphism cards representing voice/WhatsApp. 3. Dashboard Preview: Crisp, high-contrast mockups. 4. Features & CTA: Smooth scroll-driven reveals.
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard_flow: Implement Super-admin and Tenant views. Enforce tenant isolation visually via dynamic brand colors/logos if provided. Dashboard should be high-density, functional, yet incredibly clean (white/zinc palette). Include sections for AI Employees, Channels, Conversations, Settings, and Managed Customization Requests.
